title: Allow non-elevated Windows susi-release-sync timer registration at RunLevel=Limited
goal: Vision: V-3. Scope AtLogOn trigger to current user, clear StopAtDurationEnd on hourly repetition, and fall back cleanly to hourly RunLevel=Limited trigger when non-elevated Windows Task Scheduler denies TASK_TRIGGER_LOGON.

reuse.reason: Extended existing install-timer block in susi-release-sync-windows.ps1 and logon registration in install.ps1 while keeping RunLevel=Limited strict.
